issues.en: Birth took place in the village of Kulė parish (another parish). Day drafted "Д.кабря 2го", read as the 2nd (uncertain). Father's name "Госпера" uncertain. Day of baptism "двадцатьтестаго" read as twenty-sixth.
issues.lt: Tėvo vardas skaitomas „Госпера“; gimimo diena neaiški.
